"''Well, that's not really saying much.|A barker and Han Solo|}} '''Alzoc III''', also known as '''Alzoc''', was a frozen [[planet]] located in the [[Sujimis sector]] of [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]] that was the [[homeworld]] of the [[Talz]] [[species]]. The world was taken over by the [[Galactic Empire]] due to its exploitable [[mineral]] wealth. The [[pilot]] [[Praz Fateer]] was described as being the fastest on Alzoc III by a barker aboard the [[Frander's Bay]] [[space station]]. The [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] was involved in a job on Alzoc III at some point before [[9 ABY]]. ==Description== Alzoc III, also simply known as Alzoc,[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] was a terrestrial frozen [[planet]], though it was not inhospitable. The world was located in the [[Sujimis sector]] of [[the galaxy]]'s [[Outer Rim Territories]], in grid P-19 on the [[Standard Galactic Grid]]. It was rich in [[mineral]] wealth. ==History== {{Quote|Ask him about the job on Alzoc III.''"
"''I did what I had to.''"
"''Oh, but you liked it.|Xi'an and Din Djarin reflect on their job on Alzoc III|{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 6: The Prisoner}}}} During the [[High Republic Era]], the [[mercenary]] [[Ty Yorrick]] took a [[job on Alzoc III]] where she worked alongside a [[Unidentified Hoopaloo|member]] of the [[Hoopaloo]] [[species]]. The Hoopaloo betrayed her during the course of the mission, stealing half of her arsenal of equipment. Not wanting to undertake what she saw as a waste of time and effort, Yorrick accepted the loss and did not attempt to track him down.''[[The High Republic: The Rising Storm]]'' At some point following the [[Rescue on the Tranquility|rescue on the ''Tranquility'']] during the [[Clone Wars]], [[Jedi]] [[Aayla Secura]] and [[Luminara Unduli]] [[Confrontation on Alzoc III|engaged]] the [[Sith assassin]] [[Asajj Ventress]] on Alzoc III, where they incapacitated Ventress and left her trapped in an ice cave by causing a cave in.{{EncyclopediaCite|Mace Windu and Other Users of the Force}} During the [[Imperial Era]], the [[Galactic Empire]] discovered Alzoc III's mineral wealth, and took over the world in order to exploit it. The [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] heroes [[Landonis Balthazar Calrissian|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Han Solo]] overheard the barker's claims while searching for a pilot on the station, and Solo was unimpressed by Fateer's title. At some point prior to [[9 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' establishes that ''[[Star Wars: The Mandalorian]]'' is set in [[9 ABY]]. Therefore, the events of the "[[Chapter 6: The Prisoner]]," including the mention of the [[Job on Alzoc III (Din Djarin)|job on Alzoc III]], must have taken place in 9 ABY. the [[Mandalorian]] [[bounty hunter]] [[Din Djarin]] undertook a [[Job on Alzoc III (Din Djarin)|job on Alzoc III]] with [[Xi'an]]. When Djarin rejoined Xi'an as part of a [[Ranzar Malk's crew|team]] of [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] for a [[Bothan-Five incident|mission]], Xi'an brought up the job to the other members of the group. Djarin stated he had done what he needed to do, and Xi'an claimed that he had enjoyed doing it. ==Inhabitants== Alzoc III was the [[homeworld]] of the [[Talz]] [[Sentience|sentient]] [[species]]. According to a barker present on the [[Frander's Bay]] [[space station]] in [[7 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' dates the events of ''[[Last Shot]]'' to twenty-seven [[Standard year|years]] before the [[Hosnian Cataclysm]], placed in [[34 ABY]] by ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]''. Therefore, the events of ''Last Shot'', including the mention of Alzoc III, are set in [[7 ABY]]. [[Praz Fateer]] was the fastest [[pilot]] on Alzoc III. ==Behind the scenes== Alzoc III was first mentioned in the new ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]] on a [[map]] in the article [[Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of Star Wars: The Force Awakens?|Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''?]], published on [[StarWars.com]] on [[January 29]], [[2016]].{{SW|url=news/where-in-the-galaxy-are-the-worlds-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens|text=Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''?|int=Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of Star Wars: The Force Awakens?}} It was later identified as Alzoc III in the [[Star Wars Helmet Collection 2|second issue]] of [[De Agostini]]'s ''[[Star Wars Helmet Collection]]'' magazine series, published in [[2016]]. In the [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity, [[Alzoc III/Legends|Alzoc III]] was first mentioned in ''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]'', a supplement to ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' written by [[Troy Denning]] and published by [[West End Games]] in [[1989]].''[[Galaxy Guide 4: Alien Races]]'' ==Appearances== *''[[The High Republic: The Rising Storm]]'' {{Ab|The High Republic: The Rising Storm (audiobook)}} {{Mo}} *''[[Last Shot]]'' {{Ab|Last Shot (audiobook)}} {{Mo}} *{{TheMandalorian|Chapter 6: The Prisoner}} {{Mo}} *[[The Mandalorian 6|''The Mandalorian'' 6]] {{Mo}} ===Non-canon appearances=== *{{FreemakerAdventures|A Perilous Rescue}} {{Mo}} ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Alzoc III}} *{{HelmetCollectionCite|2|Databank A-Z}} {{1stID|Alzoc III}} *{{SW|url=news/where-in-the-galaxy-are-the-worlds-of-star-wars-the-force-awakens|text=Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of ''Star Wars: The Force Awakens''?|int=Where in the Galaxy Are the Worlds of Star Wars: The Force Awakens?}} {{1stm}} {{MapPoint}} *[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]] {{MapPoint}} *''[[Endless Vigil]]'' *{{EncyclopediaCite|Din Djarin and Other Characters of the Underworld}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Mace Windu and Other Users of the Force}} *''[[Star Wars: Dawn of Rebellion: The Visual Guide]]'' {{MapPoint}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |es=Alzoc III |fr=Alzoc III |hu=Alzoc III |ka=ალზოკ III }} [[Category:Alzoc system locations]] [[Category:Galactic Empire planets]] [[Category:Planets in the Outer Rim Territories]] [[Category:Planets in the Trailing Sectors]] [[Category:Terrestrial planets]]
